verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms llms.txt is served (HTTP 200) at developers.llamaindex.ai, and the docs have a dedicated 'for-agents' section. That section includes a docs MCP server exposing search_docs, grep_docs and read_doc, plus a one-line `claude mcp add` command for pointing an agent at the docs. missing for 10: per-page markdown docs (the .md probe returned 404), independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: My agent should be able to search these docs
The server ships with the following tools: 1. `search_docs` — a basic lexical search using BM25 2. `grep_docs` — exact search using regex 3. `read_doc`
Give your AI agent access to these docs: `claude mcp add llama-index-docs --transport http https://developers.llamaindex.ai/mcp`
